DZA.note: Nothing on rules or an authority for AI harms.
AI chatbots and fraud detection are only announced for 2027; the investment platform is not AI.
AI map and fraud prevention for solidarity schemes are announced for 2027, not under way or in service.

facts.fact: The Ministry of National Solidarity's communique, reported by Algerie54, refers to implementing Algeria's National AI Strategy, under which the sector plans projects for 2027.

DZA.note: A national AI map of persons with special needs is only planned for 2027 with no builder, funder or site named.

facts.fact: The Ministry of National Solidarity communique says the investment-tracking platform launched on 2026-10-20 carries out the action plan of the National Digital Transformation Strategy, on the President's instructions.
